name: Lex's 3-state regime rule on the Base policy portfolio (A v8)
author: Lex (method: the 3-state rule in backtest.ts and the May 2026 treasury post; bucket behavior from the swarm manifest, 2026-06-02). Numeric translation: Claude, 2026-10-08, using only the page's floors, targets and caps.
description: The composite label picks one of three weight sets. neutral is A v8 unchanged. risk_off: Bitcoin to 0, gold stays at its 6% cap, cash buffer 5%, 8 points move from the Morpho curated vaults and 2 from Bitcoin into sUSDS and Aave (the manifest: the yield book is the principal anchor and grows in risk-off). risk_on: Bitcoin to its 10% cap, gold 4% (the counter-cycle sleeve), the yield book keeps A's mix. Decision every Monday, regime computed as-of the previous Friday, trade at Monday's close.
label: composite
